charter: Actual workflow shell, original exit preservation, same-step TMPDIR/producer compatibility and useful source-bound make/unittest/Python traceback identifiers. No integration, push or remote CI verdict.

criteria.criterion: Preserve original gate exit and healthy behavior
criteria.evidence: Existing tests execute the exact extracted workflow run block with inert docker/make/python stand-ins. Gate exit 7 remains 7 with successful diagnostics and with reporter exit 9. Healthy exit 0 remains 0, reporter is not invoked, no error annotations appear.

criteria.criterion: Use actual producer directory/log contract in the same workflow step
criteria.evidence: The exported TMPDIR reaches make check and is passed unchanged to the reporter. Producer creates TMPDIR/db-<16 lowercase hex>/gate.log, root mode 0700 and log mode 0600, matching the consumer. Cleanup retains this log. The explicit producer file mode rules out the proposed umask incompatibility.

criteria.criterion: Emit useful bounded identifiers tied to current source
criteria.evidence: Make targets are checked against Makefile; unittest selectors against a tracked test module AST/class/method; traceback locations against tracked source and a valid line range. Existing controls verify these values, tail-only selection, bounded output and unavailable fallback. Read-only replay of the retained local failed log independently returned check-development, the exact test_test_db_gate selector, source frames and UnsafeFixture.

criteria.criterion: Do not change canonical gate behavior or pins
criteria.evidence: The diff changes only failure observation around the unchanged make check command. Makefile and producer bytes are unchanged from base; Docker image pin, toolchain setup, pre-provisioning checks and 3600-second gate timeout are unchanged. Reporter is a separate Python process after make returns, not a replacement gate.

executions.boundary: Historical LOCAL log only, not the unknown remote failure. No log contents copied; only source-validated identifiers emitted. This exercises summarize, not diagnostics directory discovery on the retained renamed layout.
